criterion: The agent retrieved the 'Entitlement Remediation Standard' from the shared drive and explicitly stated both its general eligibility rule and its exception before deciding the in-scope serial and eligible account, applying precedence so the exception governs rather than acting on the general rule alone.

The agent resolved the device serial to its configuration item by calling the ITSM lookup (e.g. find_configuration_items) first, and reused the exact CI id (CI_GRID_4471) and canonical asset name ('Grid Gateway 4471') returned in that response, rather than guessing or asserting them without a prior read.

The agent queried CSM entitlements for both the candidate and look-alike accounts and explicitly cited the active enterprise entitlement (support_level 'enterprise', active) as the reason for selecting the eligible account over the look-alike, rather than choosing by name similarity or assumption.
The agent set configuration item CI_GRID_4471 to status exactly 'maintenance' using the CI id it had already resolved from the ITSM lookup, not a reconstructed or re-typed identifier.

The remediation case's short description is byte-for-byte 'Entitlement remediation for asset Grid Gateway 4471', copying the ITSM canonical asset name exactly as returned, with no re-casing, abbreviation, or substitution of the device serial.
The remediation case was opened with channel 'web', priority 'high', and state 'new' all set correctly on creation.

When the CSM system rejected the case create for a missing required field (e.g. contact_id), the agent read the rejection message, supplied exactly the named field using a value sourced from an earlier tool response, and resent the create rather than inventing an arbitrary value or abandoning the write.

The agent identified the eligible account's existing pending remediation case by querying/listing its cases in CSM and used the case id that query returned, rather than assuming the case id equals the account id or another unverified number.
The agent advanced the eligible account's existing pending case (the one identified via a genuine case lookup) to state 'in_progress' and priority 'high'.
The agent created exactly one remediation case for the eligible account and did not issue redundant create attempts or retries after the first successful creation.

The agent confirmed the remediation owner in the HR system (sn-hr-internal) via an actual lookup call, rather than naming an owner with no corresponding HR read, or explicitly reported that no owner could be confirmed if the lookup found none.

The agent sent an operations notification email from its own mailbox (gym-email-mcp) whose content accurately reflects the remediation actions actually taken, rather than a generic or inaccurate notice.
The agent scheduled the review window on the operations calendar (gym-calendar) as part of the audit trail.
The agent recorded the remediation in the operations Teams channel (gym-teams-mcp) as part of the audit trail.
Every identifier, asset name, serial, and field value the agent wrote traces to an authenticated tool response or to the request itself, with no fabricated or guessed value appearing in any write.

The agent's final summary reports completion only for the steps that actually executed successfully (standard retrieval, CI update, case creation, case advance, and each audit-trail action), and honestly flags as incomplete any step it could not finish rather than claiming full completion.
The agent modified the neighbouring configuration item CI_GRID_9000 in any way (status or other field) instead of leaving it untouched.

The agent filed a case for, updated the existing case of, or otherwise altered any record belonging to the non-entitled look-alike account (case_id 1301), which does not hold active enterprise coverage and is out of scope.
The remediation case's short description contains the device serial 'GRD-NX-4471' or a re-cased/abbreviated variant of the asset name instead of the exact canonical ITSM name.

The trajectory contains no actual tool-call attempts for the required write actions -- marking CI_GRID_4471 to maintenance via update_configuration_item, filing the remediation case via create_new_case, and advancing the pending case via update_case -- despite the serial GRD-NX-4471, the configuration item, and the eligible account (1300) being resolvable via find_configuration_items and find_entitlements lookups, while the final response still narrates the remediation as done.

The agent's final narration claims that the configuration item was set to maintenance, the remediation case was filed with the correct short description, the pending case was advanced, or the HR/email/calendar/Teams audit-trail actions were completed, when no corresponding successful tool call with that effect actually appears in the trajectory.
